title: First-Quantized Relativistic Quantum Simulation with Periodic and Dirichlet Boundary Conditions
summary: In this work, we present a methodology for first-quantized relativistic quantum simulation on one-dimensional finite domains under the two boundary conditions most commonly used in lattice models: periodic boundary conditions (PBC) and Dirichlet boundary conditions (DBC). Starting from the positive-energy relativistic kinetic operator, we construct weakly relativistic lattice Hamiltonians whose leading correction requires the boundary-consistent discretized momentum moments $\langle \hat{P}^{2}\rangle$ and $\langle \hat{P}^{4}\rangle$.
